segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לֹא יֵשֵׁב בְּצִילָּהּ, וְאִם יָשַׁב — טָהוֹר, וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר תַּחְתֶּיהָ, וְאִם עָבַר — טָמֵא. הָיְתָה גּוֹזֶלֶת אֶת הָרַבִּים וְעָבַר תַּחְתֶּיהָ — טָהוֹר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to an ashera, «one may not sit in its shade, but if one sat» in its shade he remains «ritually pure. And one may not pass beneath it, and if one passed» beneath it he is «ritually impure.» If the tree «was robbing the public,» i.e., if its branches extended over public property, «and one passed beneath it,» he remains «pure.»

moves.summary: rules on shade and passing beneath an ashera

positions.claim: one may not sit in its shade but remains pure if he did; passing under it renders impure, unless it overhangs public ground
